source.source_name: APR Central Register of Beneficial Owners (CEV)
source.access: restricted eID portal / separate contracted web service
source.data_freshness: current register; delivery SLA per contract

parsing.notes: Implement only after APR supplies the service specification and privacy/security review approves processing. Raw source preservation must use encrypted restricted storage, not the normal open-data bucket.

mapping_rules.company_id: Map APR matični broj as an 8-digit string.
mapping_rules.owner_uid: Stable SHA-256 relationship key from source identity + normalized person key + basis discriminator; do not build it from a name alone.
mapping_rules.personal_identifiers: Normalize only in a protected transform, emit keyed HMAC-SHA256, then discard the raw identifier before ClickHouse.
mapping_rules.basis: Preserve raw APR code/label; normalize known OSV/TR code variants separately.
mapping_rules.country_codes: Map the APR code list to ISO-3166-1 alpha-2 while retaining raw source payload in restricted storage.
mapping_rules.history: Append immutable observations and resolve a ReplacingMergeTree current row with explicit is_current tombstones.
mapping_rules.members: Never infer beneficial ownership from the public-search Članovi section.

fixture_requirements: After contracting, create redacted/synthetic fixtures for each person_kind.
Cover OSV1 percentage, OSV2/OSV3 control, OSV4/TR trust, OSV5 foundation and OSV6/OSV7 fallback bases.
Cover identifier omission, source deletion/tombstone, discrepancy and supporting-document metadata.
Do not commit real names, JMBG, passport/card numbers, birth details or supporting documents.

live_test_plan.smoke: With approved test credentials, fetch one APR-provided test entity; assert key mapping and that no raw personal identifier reaches logs, artifacts or ClickHouse.
live_test_plan.full: Reconcile source counts, basis-code coverage, tombstones and duplicate owner keys; test HMAC determinism in the protected transform and verify column-level access controls.

blockers: The CEV portal requires APR eID/SSO and no user credentials were supplied.
The contracted automated-delivery protocol, schema, change semantics and fees are not publicly documented.
A lawful basis, data-protection impact review, retention policy and access controls are required before ingesting personal data.
APR must confirm whether discrepancy and supporting-document metadata are included in the contracted service.
